title: Why Drain Traps Lose Their Water Seal
description: When a plumbing fixture drains without proper venting, the rapidly flowing water creates negative air pressure within the drainage pipe. This atmospheric pressure differential acts like a vacuum, pulling the protective water seal straight out of the P-trap. Without this essential liquid barrier, foul odors and sewer gases travel freely into the building interior. Understanding how siphonage drains trap seals allows plumbers to properly diagnose recurring sewer smells and install correct venting solutions to keep air pressure balanced across the system.

Understanding how siphonage drains trap seals allows plumbers to properly diagnose recurring sewer smells and install correct venting solutions to keep air pressure balanced across the system.
